$comment: Speculative decoding was configured correctly and did not run. The draft model loaded, no warning was raised, requests were served normally, and every speculative counter stayed at zero. A user would conclude speculation was working and be getting none of it.

system.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU

what_was_tried: -ngld 99 so the draft model was also on the GPU
-np 1, in case speculation is skipped with multiple slots
why_it_matters: The acceptance rate is what decides whether speculative decoding helps, and it is undefined here because nothing was drafted. Reporting this as an acceptance rate of 0% would say the draft model is useless and send someone to find a better one; the fault is in the runtime configuration. `analysis.speculative.acceptance_report` distinguishes the two states for exactly this reason.
not_concluded: This is not a claim that llama.cpp's speculative decoding is broken. It is a claim about this build, through these flags, on this machine -- and that it fails silently, which is the part that generalises.
